name: Farstrider Lodge
summary: Farstrider Lodge is a hunting outpost in southeastern Loch Modan. Its architecture appears to be high elven, while its residents include the high elf Vyrin Swiftwind, dwarves, and humans. Hunters and travelers come here for training, supplies, and work in the surrounding wilds.

sections.title: An Elven Haven in the Mountains
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge stands apart from the sturdy stone buildings typical of Khaz Modan. Its architecture suggests high elven craftsmanship. Vyrin Swiftwind is the only known high elf still residing here, alongside dwarves and humans. The lodge's founder and date of construction are not established.

sections.title: A Waystation for the Wilds
sections.body: Situated in the southeastern hills of Loch Modan, the lodge serves hunters and travelers exploring the surrounding wilderness. Hunter and pet trainers work here alongside merchants and people seeking help with local wildlife.

faq.q: Why is there an elven lodge in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: The lodge's architecture suggests high elven origins, and Vyrin Swiftwind is its surviving high elven resident. Its founder, construction date, and original mission are not established.

faq.q: Are there still high elves living here?
faq.answer: Only a single high elf, Vyrin Swiftwind, currently resides at the lodge. The rest of the occupants are dwarven mountaineers and human huntsmen who maintain the lodge and trade with travelers.

faq.q: What services are available at Farstrider Lodge?
faq.answer: The lodge provides hunter and pet trainers, merchants, and local requests involving the wilderness of Loch Modan.

angles.text: Farstrider Lodge is a prime sanctuary for hunters, offering both mentorship in marksmanship and beast training amidst the rich game of Loch Modan's surrounding hills.
Dwarven hunters and merchants share the lodge with human residents and the high elf Vyrin Swiftwind.
